images.cerbere:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite atlas for the original 2D military science-fiction side-scrolling game ORDRE DE CENDRE.
Style: sophisticated hand-painted game sprites, detailed tactile matte surfaces, precise silhouettes, soft restrained upper-left illumination, grounded believable alien ecology and functional engineering. Orthographic SIDE view, facing RIGHT. Flat side projection, NOT isometric or a 3/4 perspective. True transparent alpha everywhere outside isolated sprites. NO scenery, ground plane, cast shadow, border, panel background, grid lines, captions, text, numbers or watermark. Every cell has generous transparent padding and its sprite stays entirely inside it. Absolutely no overlap between cells. The following reading order is LEFT to RIGHT then TOP to BOTTOM. Consistent scale, anatomy and identity across states.
Create a SQUARE atlas, EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS and 4 ROWS, SIXTEEN separate modular mechanical pieces in equal square cells.
Subject: CERBERE, imposing enemy Imperial biped heavy walker. Same functional industrial family as the painted player walkers but distinct antagonist silhouette: wide high-shouldered armored command hull, dark desaturated burgundy iron and charcoal graphite panels, faded ivory chevrons without letters, small slit of warm amber armored glazing on the RIGHT, lower ventral mounting plate, battered steel bolts and hinges. Hull width about 1.9 times height. No animal heads, no skulls, no fantasy ornament.
ROW 1: intact HULL ONLY; same hull damaged with dents and one localized breached panel; same hull braced with integral locks engaged; detached gun assembly, round pivot socket LEFT and straight long heavy barrel RIGHT, muzzle precisely on horizontal line through pivot center.
ROW 2: horizontal upper leg segment with circular sockets at both ends; same upper segment damaged preserving endpoints; horizontal lower leg segment with round sockets at both ends; same lower segment damaged preserving endpoints.
ROW 3: circular HIP joint face; circular KNEE joint face; single broad armored FOOT with perfectly flat horizontal sole and clear ankle socket above center; same FOOT damaged.
ROW 4: same FOOT braced, integrated cleats with same sole footprint; tall rectangular ribbed RADIATOR panel; same radiator damaged with bent dark fins; same radiator repaired with small fresh patch.
Critical: hull cells contain NO legs, NO feet, NO gun, NO external radiator and NO round turret baked onto their sides. The gun will mount separately below hull. All segment socket centers share one horizontal axis. Joints perfectly circular viewed side-on. No pistons crossing separate parts. Each cell shows exactly one specified disconnected piece. Maintain identical dimensions and pivot positions between damage states. No smoke, no sparks, no ground shadow.
